strapiBlog.title: OMNIYAT Unveils LUMENA ALTA: A Tower of Light, Vision, and Infinite Possibility
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai’s skyline is about to gain a new masterpiece, Lumena Alta. This ultra-luxury commercial tower, when completed, will rise as a new expression of modern design and ambition, blending creativity with purpose.

data.text:
Dubai’s skyline is about to gain a new masterpiece, Lumena Alta. This ultra-luxury commercial tower, when completed, will rise as a new expression of modern design and ambition, blending creativity with purpose. Standing at 380 metres, Lumena Alta Dubai will become the tallest commercial building in Business Bay.

The launch of Omniyat’s Lumena Alta marks the developer’s 20th anniversary, celebrating two decades of redefining design excellence across the UAE. Let's take a closer look at this opulent tower and its features.

About Lumena Atla Dubai

LUMENA ALTA by OMNIYAT represents Omniyat’s most impressive commercial vision to date, with a projected Gross Development Value exceeding AED 5 billion.

Designed as a next-generation mixed-use icon, the tower will feature 73 levels and over 720,000 sq. ft. of premium office space.

Its sculptural façade, reflecting and refracting light throughout the day, will capture the essence of its name, derived from the Latin words lumen (light) and alta (elevated).

Following the success of LUMENA and ENARA, Omniyat has launched Lumena Alta, continuing its legacy of crafting spaces that merge art, architecture, and functionality. The development will feature luxury office spaces designed for global visionaries, innovators, and corporate leaders.

Lumena Alta by Omniyat Features and Amenities

Each of the 73 floors in LUMENA ALTA by OMNIYAT will feature shell-and-core offices, many with private terraces and landscaped sky gardens, providing a sense of openness and connection to nature rarely found in commercial towers.

The project's lifestyle podium will host curated retail and dining outlets, while its 1,000 parking spaces, valet services, and triple-height sky lobbies add to the project’s sense of grandeur.

Crowning Lumena Alta is the Sky Pool suspended at 335 metres - set to become the world’s highest infinity pool - accompanied by a five-star lifestyle hotel and a panoramic Sky Restaurant offering 360-degree views of the glistening Dubai skyline.

Omniyat continues to prioritize wellness and innovation in design. Lumena Alta luxury office spaces in Dubai incorporate advanced technology, wellness-focused amenities, and sustainable design practices.

Tenants will enjoy access to private fitness suites, hydrotherapy zones, spa facilities, and vitality pools designed to promote health and productivity. The Executive Club will feature private boardrooms and sky lounges overlooking the city.

The tower is targeting multiple global certifications, including LEED Platinum for sustainability, WELL Platinum for wellness standards, and Platinum WiredScore and SmartScore for digital connectivity and smart infrastructure. These accreditations reflect Omniyat’s commitment to creating intelligent, sustainable, and people-centric spaces.

data.text:
Five-Star Hospitality and Concierge Services

LUMENA ALTA by OMNIYAT seamlessly integrates hospitality within its commercial framework. As part of Omniyat’s growing portfolio of high-end developments, it will offer five-star services managed directly by the developer.

People will be able to access concierge support for meeting coordination, event management, spa and wellness services, lifestyle bookings, luxury travel arrangements, and bespoke experiences - all delivered with Omniyat’s signature attention to detail.

Location and Connectivity

Situated at the gateway to Business Bay, LUMENA ALTA by OMNIYAT offers unmatched accessibility and visibility. The tower will connect directly to the future Dubai Metro Gold Line, ensuring seamless access to key commercial and cultural destinations, including DIFC, Downtown Dubai, Dubai South, and DXB Airport.

faqs.question: Where is LUMENA ALTA by OMNIYAT located?

data.answer: It is located on Sheikh Zayed Road, at the intersection of Business Bay and Downtown Dubai, with direct access to major districts and the upcoming Dubai Metro Gold Line.
The project features a sculptural façade, world-class amenities, the world’s highest infinity pool, and five-star hospitality services, making it one of Dubai’s most exclusive commercial towers.

faqs.question: What certifications will Lumena Alta pursue?

data.answer: The project aims for LEED Platinum, WELL Platinum, WiredScore Platinum, and SmartScore Platinum certifications, reflecting its focus on sustainability, wellness, and technology.

faqs.question: Who is the developer of Lumena Alta?

data.answer: Omniyat, a leading luxury real estate developer in Dubai, is the developer behind Lumena Alta.
